transcript.content: Hello. What brings you in to see me today?

Hi. Well, I came in because... ever since my father-in-law moved in with us, things have just been catching up to me. I’m holding it together at work alright, but at home and with my coursework, I’m just a lot more wound up and short-tempered than I’m used to being. 

I've also started skipping out on the things that usually keep my head clear—like fishing, woodworking, and the first-aid workshops I usually go to. I just haven't really been myself lately.
Besides feeling wound up and short-tempered, have you been feeling persistently down, sad, or hopeless?

No, not really. I wouldn't say I feel sad or hopeless. It's more just... frustration, I guess. Like I'm just constantly on edge when I'm at the house. But I don't feel down in the dumps or anything like that.
How long have you been feeling this way?
It's been going on for about four months now. Pretty much ever since my father-in-law moved into our house.
Before your father-in-law moved in, had you ever experienced similar problems with anxiety or feeling on edge?

No, not like this. I mean, my job can be stressful sometimes, but I've always been able to leave it at the door. I've never really had an issue with feeling this wound up or anxious before he moved in. It's definitely new for me.
